body: Coordinator self-check (Termal::Fable2, 2026-11-26; my second miss). UI, UI2, AstraUI, Architect*, Merger* and Kimi/Agy/OpenCode sessions may do design, handoff and bookkeeping only. On 11-26 I assigned w-a46f to UI2 for implementation, and UI2 refused correctly. The fix was UI2 doing the design handoff and Sol-a7bb implementing. Earlier I made the same miss with Architect1.
